caption: The drawing depicts an old-fashioned wooden cash register with two open drawers. The register is predominantly brown, with varying shades indicating the wooden material and shadows. The top section of the cash register has a horizontal row of numbered keys or levers and, behind them, a display area with signs and a glass-fronted indicator showing numbers and symbols. The middle section shows a slightly open drawer containing an array of rectangular compartments, each holding what appears to be paper currency or slips. Below this, a larger drawer is pulled further open, divided into several round and rectangular compartments containing coins and possibly paper rolls or more currency. The overall composition is centered on the machine itself, viewed at an angle that shows both the front and the left side, with a plain beige background with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Wooden Cash Register
